description: This PHP source file defines the ReturnReason class within the Opencart admin controller namespace. It manages tasks related to return reasons, including generating task lists, creating JSON files of return reasons, and clearing those files. The class interacts with models for store, language, and return reasons, and handles file operations for localization data.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: Controller class for managing return reason tasks, including listing, generating JSON files, and clearing localization files.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of return reason tasks for each store and language.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Creates a JSON file of return reasons for a specific store and language.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes generated JSON localization files for return reasons across all stores and languages.
